episode_title: Jon Bartos with Dimensional Search. Turning Industry Experience into a Recruiting Franchise

real_qa.q: What is Dimensional Search and how does it differ from Sanford Rose Associates?
real_qa.r: Dimensional Search is a separate franchise brand launched to serve brand-new entrepreneurs entering the recruiting industry, while Sanford Rose Associates (established 1958) focuses exclusively on scaling existing search and staffing firms. Dimensional Search operates as a 'minor league' where new franchisees build their search firm for 12 to 18 months before receiving an invitation to join Sanford Rose Associates' 'major leagues' for continued growth and scaling. The separation exists because experienced firms and startups face entirely different challenges—equity plans versus generating initial job orders and candidate flow.
real_qa.requete: Dimensional Search vs Sanford Rose Associates franchise difference

real_qa.q: How do Dimensional Search franchisees generate revenue through contract staffing and markups?
real_qa.r: Dimensional Search franchisees earn through multiple revenue streams: contract staffing typically involves a 47% markup on the pay rate to the bill rate, with ongoing recurring revenue lasting 12 to 24 months. For example, an IT architect placed at $200 per hour pay rate generates a $390 per hour bill rate. Conversion fees apply when temporary assignments convert to permanent placement. The average placement fee ranges from 25% to 33% of the executive's first-year salary, or 30% to 33% for vice president level positions and above.
real_qa.requete: Dimensional Search contract staffing markup percentage revenue

real_qa.q: What support systems does Dimensional Search provide to new franchisees during onboarding?
real_qa.r: Dimensional Search provides three dedicated one-on-one coaches to each franchisee: a workflow process coach working daily to ensure correct business execution, a technology coach setting up digital engagement across email automation, LinkedIn automation, and social media channels, and a performance analytics coach monitoring whether franchisees are hitting specific targets needed for business takeoff. During five weeks of facilitated foundation training, franchisees receive a mentor office in week two to immediately split searches and generate revenue, plus technology tools at a substantial discount. Within 90 days, franchisees typically hire an appointment center and researcher, with Dimensional Search handling all hiring, training, and development of these global employees.
real_qa.requete: Dimensional Search franchisee onboarding coaches support training

real_qa.q: What is the fractional talent revenue model offered by Dimensional Search franchisees?
real_qa.r: The fractional talent model is the highest-demand revenue stream in Dimensional Search, allowing small companies to hire high-level executives part-time instead of full-time. For instance, a $10 million company needing a $400,000 CMO can hire that executive fractionally at 20 hours per week for $200,000 instead of the full $400,000 salary, maintaining executive-level expertise. This arrangement continues with ongoing revenue until the talent is converted to full-time, at which point an additional fee is generated, making it one of the fastest-growing revenue models in the staffing industry.
real_qa.requete: Dimensional Search fractional talent revenue model

real_qa.q: How does Dimensional Search help franchisees acquire customers through digital engagement campaigns?
real_qa.r: Dimensional Search implements a structured digital engagement program targeting both clients and candidates. The process begins with an awareness campaign in the first month communicating who the franchisee is, what they do, and why. Compelling reasons that drive conversations include job openings, candidate recommendations, and industry insights. Within 90 days, franchisees typically earn their own searches, and an appointment setter is added to reach out to clients and spark conversations. This formula of building client and candidate databases, then launching targeted digital engagement campaigns, enables franchisees to establish their business without sharing search fees with mentor offices within approximately six months.
real_qa.requete: Dimensional Search customer acquisition digital engagement campaigns

guest.bio_context: Jon Bartos spent 20 years in the barcode data collection business after attending Michigan State University, working across multiple organizations and relocating internationally at age 26. In 1998, he founded his own recruiting firm under the MRI network, scaling it to 26 employees by 2012 and winning Rookie Officer of the Year. He subsequently led an organization from $100 million to $300 million in recruiting and staffing, then founded Global People in 2015 (recruiting and staffing in warehouse automation), which he sold to private equity firm Starfish Partners in 2022. He now runs Dimensional Search, Sanford Rose Associates, and Starfish Partners.
